item.title: Owner-occupied households (Census 2021, by Settlement)

item.description: Owner-occupied households (Settlement) from the 2021 NI Census, recorded by NISRA. Each polygon is shaded by the percentage on a viridis colour ramp; the table panel that opens at the bottom right shows the underlying count and population denominator.
